To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the auralization models are based on digital sound synthesis and that the sound synthesis is combined with sound propagation models.

(i) auralization models can be designed that allow to synthesize environmental acoustical phenomena with a high degree of perceived realism, (ii) these models are versatile with respect to scenarios, (iii) they are based on the synthesis of sound sources and the simulation of sound propagation effects, (iv) the models are parametric, i.e., the parameters are either measured or derived from data analysis, (v) the models are implemented as software tools, and (vi) the
auralization of road traffic noise is possible with a high audio quality by using additive and subtractive sound synthesis.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and evaluation of calculation models for the auralizaton of environmental acoustics scenarios, which are of relevance for the assessment of the impact of environmental noise on people.
the development of auralization models for road traffic, railway, and wind turbine noise.
auralization methods that are able to synthesize the sounds of environmental noise sources with high audio quality and a high degree of realism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the developed methods are able to create auralizations of environmental acoustics scenarios that are realistic and plausible, and that are suitable for the assessment and the communication of environmental acoustic scenarios.
the developed models provide a good basis for the auralizations of environmental acoustics.
the developed models are a significant contribution to the field of auralization of complex sound scenes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were able to establish a sound synthesis approach that is able to produce realistic sounds of wind turbine, road traffic and railway noise.

we have shown that auralization of realistic environmental noise scenarios is possible, that we have developed auralization models for the synthesis of road traffic, wind turbine and railway noise, that we have shown how to determine the input parameters for the models, and that the auralizations are judged as realistic.
auralization of realistic environmental acoustical scenarios can now be achieved by combining the proposed models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
auralization is a powerful tool for the investigation and communication of environmental sound scenarios.
auralization can be a powerful tool in the assessment of environmental noise scenarios.
, in order to create auralizations that are judged as realistic and plausible, it is necessary to consider the acoustical peculiar characteristics of the considered environmental noise scenarios.
